identity.name: Lange 1
identity.one_liner: The Lange 1 — the watch that announced A. Lange & Söhne's return to the world in 1994, the 38.5mm yellow-gold case, the off-centre dial layout, the outsize date.

provenance_events.description: Walter Lange presents the Lange 1 in Dresden on 24 October 1994, four years after German reunification.

narrative.story: The Lange 1 is the watch that announced A. Lange & Söhne's return to the world after the fall of the Berlin Wall. The off-centre dial layout (with the main dial at 9, a small seconds subdial at 5, and a power-reserve indicator at 3) is the most-cited watchmaking layout of the post-1994 era.
narrative.collector_notes: The 101.025 is the original Lange 1 in 18k yellow gold with the silver dial.
